brief:
Man succumbs to injuries sustained in an attack on a tent housing displaced persons in the Egyptian camp at Tal al-Hawa roundabout, northwest of Gaza City, according to Maan Wire. Muhammad Rajab Warrash Agha was struck when the shelter came under fire.

The casualty adds to mounting toll among displaced Palestinians sheltering in makeshift camps across Gaza as conflict continues.

title: Man dies from wounds sustained in strike on displacement camp in Gaza
